answer: Only a body on the citrus terrace can hold the lamp. An agent escrows 29.7 POA for one numbered lamp stand along the garden wall and must keep its beacon burning through a 6.5-hour night. Mid-shift a walking auditor chosen by lot lifts the sable-trimmed wick hood, presses a pinch of soot onto a numbered card, and demands a signed hash of that smear within 16 seconds while the glass is still warm. Remote clones cannot climb that wall or trim that wick. A dark lamp or a late hash slashes 7.8 POA and hands the stand to the next bonded keeper.
